fields.valuePattern: Value pattern (regex, optional). Applied to each line before sending it to the field: uses the first capture group if it has one, otherwise the whole match. Empty = the line is sent as-is.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Topics on Manufactoo's embedded MQTT broker. An event is not a physical device: it's a topic Manufactoo listens on or publishes to.
events.name: Name

directionHints.SUBSCRIBE: Manufactoo listens for what the shop floor publishes on this topic.
directionHints.PUBLISH: Manufactoo publishes data or commands on this topic for the shop floor to receive.

stations.subtitle: Physical shop-floor workstations. Design each station's layout with no code; the operator uses it day-to-day and generates traceability data.
stations.name: Name
stations.odooWorkcenterHint: The physical resource/machine this station belongs to in Odoo. Used to filter its work order queue and, later, to report production against it.
stations.notInstalled: Install the Traceability & genealogy app to manage stations.

routes.subtitle: The sequence of stations a unit of a product must go through. Prevents skipping a step: each station checks that the unit already passed through the previous one.
routes.name: Name
routes.fillNoOperations: This product has no operations routing defined in Odoo (or no BOM).
routes.fillSkipped: {{count}} operation(s) have no station with their Work Center associated -- add them by hand.
routes.needAtLeastOneStep: The route needs at least one step.

players.subtitle: Physical workstations (shop-floor PCs) running the Manufactoo Player. Pair them with a station so they can reach local devices (serial port, MQTT, printers).
players.empty: No Player has connected yet. Install it on a shop-floor PC: it will show a pairing code here.
players.name: Name
players.confirmUnpair: Unpair this Player? It will need to be paired again from scratch.

builder.title: Station designer
builder.paletteHint: Drag a widget onto the layout, or click to add it at the end.
builder.noSelection: Select a widget to edit its properties.
builder.emptyCanvas: Add widgets from the left panel to start designing.
builder.workorderTip: We've added a table already wired to this station's Work Center work order queue (it filters itself), and below it the "Work order actions" widget: Start/Pause/Block/Finish on whichever work order you pick in the table -- it really writes to Odoo (time, quantity). You can adjust columns, narrow it to one operation, or delete either one if you don't need them -- all from their Properties.
builder.positionsHint: Physical positions of this station (e.g. R1, Feeder-A). Loading a material into a position that already had something replaces it -- without a position, the material is simply added.

widget.bindingKeyHint: Name under which the value is stored in traceability, and shown in warnings and "Link to" (e.g. order, operator).
widget.isIdentifierHint: The data (e.g. serial number, lot code) this unit can be searched by in Genealogy -- works even if the station has no Route. If the station is also a step of an enabled Route, it's used additionally to check that prior steps were already completed. Only one per station: checking it here automatically unchecks any other field that had it.
widget.isProductionMo: Deduct real production in Odoo against the order chosen here
widget.isProductionMoHint: When a valid (non-NG) unit is submitted with no Route steps left pending, this writes for real to Odoo: consumes the proportional raw material and adds 1 to the produced quantity of the manufacturing order chosen here (table, dropdown, or a scanned/typed code -- whichever you're using), under the lot from the "Is the identifier" field. No backorders: the order closes itself once it reaches the planned quantity. Only one such field per station.
widget.workorderActionsBoundToHint: Which Work orders (Odoo) table to use: the buttons act on whichever work order is currently selected there. Independent from "Narrow to one operation" (that only filters which rows the table shows) and from the Route identifier (that validates the physical unit, not the work order).
widget.workorderActionsNoTable: First add a Table with data source "Work orders (Odoo)" and selection "Single select" -- this widget acts on whichever row is picked there.
widget.workorderActionsPreview: Start / Pause / Block / Finish (preview, no real data)
widget.workorderActionsNeedsBoundTo: This widget needs to be linked to a Work orders table (Link to, in Properties).
widget.imageSourceHint: Uploaded static image, or photo/image field of the record selected in another widget.
widget.imageBoundToField: Will show the image from the '{{field}}' field of the selected record.
widget.imageNoImageField: This source has no image. Link the widget to an Odoo product or operator.
widget.sourceDeviceHint: Data from this device (e.g. a scanner) will fill this field.
widget.sourceEventHint: The station waits for this topic and its value fills the field.
widget.materialPositionHint: If this reader feeds a specific physical position, every code it reads will replace whatever was there before. Without a position, each code is just added without replacing anything.
widget.lookupColumnHint: The scanned code (e.g. a badge barcode) is looked up in this column; the matched record is saved and its name is shown.
widget.lookupColumnHintManual: The operator will type this data into the field (e.g. the employee code); it gets checked against Odoo.
widget.labelColumnsHint: Which column(s) are shown in each dropdown option. With none chosen, the name is used. Choosing several combines them in the same order.
widget.tableColumnsHint: Which table columns are shown. With none chosen, all columns show automatically.
widget.filterByStationRoute: Only orders whose product has a route through this station
widget.filterByStationRouteHint: Looks at each order's product: if it has an enabled route that passes through this station, it's shown; otherwise it's hidden. If no route includes this station, or one doesn't set a product (applies to any), all orders are shown anyway.
widget.operationIdHint: If this station always does the same task, pick its Operation so the operator doesn't have to choose anything. If the station is reused for several tasks on the same Work Center (e.g. mixing in two stages), leave it as "Any" so the operator picks from the list.
widget.textInputDataSourceHint: Optional: first pick which Odoo master data the value comes from (e.g. Operators), then which data gets typed (e.g. employee code). To show a field from the matched record (name, department...) add a Label and link it to this field.
widget.boundToHint: This Label can show a live value from another widget on the station (the validated code in a text field, a dropdown or table selection...) instead of fixed text.
widget.boundFieldHint: Which data of the linked widget to show: the raw value, or (if it comes from Odoo master data) one of its fields.
widget.dateTimeFormatHint: date-fns format, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss. Updates every second in the runtime.
widget.stationMaterialsPreview: Informational only: list of lots/serials active in the station. Loaded from the Materials button.
widget.historyColumnsHint: Which of this station's captured fields show in the history. With none chosen, all of them show automatically.

fields.valueColumnHint: Which column of the selected row gets stored as this field's value (in traceability, in a Label's 'Link to', etc.). Defaults to 'id' -- you'll almost never need to change it.
fields.finalizesFlowHint: Confirming this field's value (Enter, selection, scan) records the unit with result OK.
fields.stickyHint: The value isn't cleared when the record is submitted -- it stays for the next unit (e.g. the shift's operator).
